subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Sprint owners, benchmarks & prompt ownership
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <cpark@neuropathbio.com>, Marco Ruiz <mruiz@neuropathbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Sprint owners, benchmarks & prompt ownership

Hi Claire + Marco,

Thanks again for taking the time last week — excited to get the MAP in motion for the Neuropath Bio evaluation. I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a short benchmark plan (benchmark-plan.pdf) to this thread. High-level asks below so we can align owners and lock the close cadence.

Goal: 3-week POC to validate: 1) inference latency at clinical load, 2) prompt accuracy on structured extraction (clinical fields), 3) end-to-end cost per throughput target.

Proposed success criteria (please review):
- Latency: p95 < 400ms for inference at 8 concurrent sessions
- Accuracy: F1 >= 0.88 on the labeled extraction set (see evaluation-profiles.csv)
- Throughput cost: <= $0.015/token equivalent on our dedicated config

Suggested owner roles (Redwood):
- Benchmarks & evaluation harness: Soojin Lee (SE) — runs synthetic load and collates metrics
- Prompt/eval steward: Marissa Cole (CS) — owns prompt library, golden prompts, and qualitative reviews
- Commercial / logistics: Ben Carter (AE) — procurement and timing
- Rollout/canary policy: Jordan Blake (Product Ops) — handles model variants and fallback rules

Request from Neuropath Bio (please confirm):
- Technical lead for test data and acceptance criteria
- Procurement contact for PO / NDA timelines
- Availability for a 45-min kickoff next week to assign action items and confirm benchmark dataset delivery

Next steps I propose this week:
1) You confirm internal Neuropath stakeholders and any constraints (data access, VPN, whitelisting)
2) We refine the MAP spreadsheet and share the live link
3) Schedule the kickoff (I listed a couple of slots in the attached sheet)

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (worksheets: timeline, owners, acceptance), benchmark-plan.pdf (bench definitions), evaluation-profiles.csv (sample schema)

Thanks — I’ll hold Tuesday/Thursday mornings PT for a kickoff but happy to adjust.

—
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Park <cpark@neuropathbio.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <mruiz@neuropathbio.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Sprint owners, benchmarks & prompt ownership

Thanks Soojin — this looks great and clear. A couple quick notes from our side:

1) Please add our technical lead: Dr. Elena Soto <esoto@neuropathbio.com> — she will own the labeled extraction set and the ground-truth reviews.
2) Procurement: please include Lena Cho <lcho@neuropathbio.com> on procurement and PO timelines.
3) KPI weighting — our team will prioritize accuracy (60%) over latency (25%) and cost (15%) for the initial acceptance. Can you reflect that in the benchmark doc?

For kickoff availability, Thursday 7/8 at 10:00 AM PT works for Elena + me. We prefer a 45-minute sync with a short demo and then assignment of owners.

—
Claire Park
Director of Product, Neuropath Bio
cpark@neuropathbio.com | +1 (617) 555-2224
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <cpark@neuropathbio.com>, Marco Ruiz <mruiz@neuropathbio.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Sprint owners, benchmarks & prompt ownership

Claire — great, thanks for the clarifications. I updated the MAP spreadsheet with Dr. Soto and Lena as contacts and added KPI weighting per your note (accuracy 60%). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-EXAMPLE-MAP (I also attached the updated MAP file to this email).

Confirming kickoff: Thu 8 Jul, 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET — I’ll send calendar invite after you confirm (inviting Elena and Lena). Agenda: 1) 10-min intro & demo, 2) owners & acceptance criteria, 3) benchmark dataset delivery plan, 4) procurement timelines.

Action items for Redwood before kickoff:
- Soojin: finalize the synthetic load plan and share exact data format expected (CSV schema in evaluation-profiles.csv)
- Marissa: prepare prompt library and initial golden prompts for the demo
- Jordan: map model variant and fallback plan for canary

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (updated), benchmark-plan.pdf

—
Ben Carter
